title: Firmware Attacks on Network Edge Devices | PJ Networks
body:
In late 2024 and through 2025, a string of sophisticated attacks targeting network edge devices — firewalls, VPN gateways, and SD-WAN appliances — moved from theoretical risk to documented reality. Threat actors, including state-sponsored groups, have been exploiting zero-day vulnerabilities in edge devices not simply to gain entry, but to persist within firmware and survive factory resets. For Indian enterprise IT leaders, this is no longer a headline from abroad. As CERT-In advisories and [...] Firmware-level attacks on edge devices represent a maturation of the threat landscape that demands a corresponding maturation in defensive operations. Patching remains the single most important control — the vast majority of successful exploits target known, patched vulnerabilities that have not yet been applied. But patching alone does not address the detection gap that allows firmware implants to persist unnoticed, nor the response gap that makes CERT-In’s 6-hour reporting window challenging [...] PJ Networks helps Indian enterprises deploy and operate exactly this kind of layered control set, anchored by FortiGate/Fortinet platforms and the PrahiX Ora unified SecOps stack. title: Report: Nvidia in advanced talks to acquire Stanford-led diffusion AI startup Inception for $500M+ — TFN
body:
In September 2026, Nvidia agreed to acquire Hugging Face, the French-founded open-source AI platform, for about $12.9 billion. Nvidia expects the deal to close in the first half of 2027, and the US Department of Justice has asked the company how it could affect competitors. Nvidia had previously participated in Hugging Face’s $235 million Series D funding round in 2023. [...] - Nvidia is reportedly in advanced talks to buy diffusion AI startup Inception for over $500M.

<!--THE END-->

- The deal would bring Inception’s three co-founders into Nvidia full-time.

<!--THE END-->

- Inception raised a $50M seed round in November 2025, with Nvidia among its backers. [...] The potential acquisition fits into Nvidia’s broader strategy to expand beyond its role as a leading supplier of AI computing hardware. The company has been investing in AI models, software platforms, and research teams that could strengthen its wider ecosystem.

title: The chip landscape
body: Enhancing the resilience of the complex semiconductor value chain requires better data. This paper strengthens the evidence base for semiconductor policy by mapping global semiconductor wafer fabrication capacity by economy, process node density, process technology and business model, building on the newly assembled OECD Semiconductor Production Database. The results show that semiconductor production capacity is highly geographically concentrated and underscore the importance of distinguishing [...] of distinguishing between different semiconductor types and the limited scope for substitutability of production between fabrication plants. This structural rigidity creates bottlenecks that can amplify the impact of supply disruptions and limit the scope for remedial actions. title: What makes Singapore a prime location for semiconductor companies driving innovation? | Singapore EDB
body:
Global demand for semiconductors continues to grow, with the market projected to reach US$1.6 trillion (S$2.03t) by 20301 — fuelled by the rapid rise of artificial intelligence (AI) and the electrification of vehicles.

Singapore is a critical node in this global ecosystem, attracting over S$30 billion in semiconductor investments from 2022 to 2025. Today, we account for one in 10 chips and one in five semiconductor equipment units worldwide. [...] Developing world-leading capabilities in areas expected to underpin the next wave of semiconductor growth, such as advanced packaging, heterogeneous integration, and photonics.
 Aligning public R&D with industry needs.
 Growing local companies in partnership with MNCs and through venture building.
 Attracting and developing talent. [...] WHAT WE ARE DOING Singapore fosters deep collaboration between global semiconductor players and local enterprises that serve as solution providers and co-development partners. These partnerships accelerate capability building while strengthening overall ecosystem resilience.
